reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Material disclosures required prior to debt contract
headings.reviewNote: Mandates debt adjusters provide clear disclosures regarding result timelines, settlement percentages, credit risks, and fund ownership.

headings.title: Prohibited misrepresentations regarding debt relief services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits misrepresentations concerning debt relief savings, timelines, creditor negotiations, credit impact, success rates, or nonprofit status.

headings.title: Prerequisite conditions for receiving fee payments
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits debt adjuster fee collection until debt terms are altered, debtor makes payment, and fees comply with proportional or savings caps.

headings.title: Trust account requirements for held funds
headings.reviewNote: Regulates debtor funds held in insured financial institution accounts and guarantees unconditional withdrawal rights within seven business days.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 2011 enactment note; confirmed pre-contract debt adjuster disclosures, misrepresentation prohibitions, fee-collection prerequisites, and insured-account fund/7-day withdrawal rules.
